name: Nitto Kogyo Corporation
summary: Nitto Kogyo Corporation manufactures and sells electric and mechanical equipment worldwide. The company offers high-voltage power receiving equipment and panel boards, home panel boards, charging stations, residential and standard distribution boards, electronic equipment, control panels, cubicle type unit substations, EV/PHEV charging equipment, private work booth, and fiber-optic splice boxes; plastic and metal enclosures; server racks; circuit breakers, switches, and terminal blocks; and thermal management products, as well as panel parts for exterior, interior, mounting, wiring, cubicle, connector, and electromagnetic shielding.
